customFindings.issue: Bank Info API: Insufficient rate limiting - 100 requests succeeded
Forget Password API: Doesn't work without auth - this breaks the user flow!

zapFindings.solution:
Ensure that sensitive data is not available in an unauthenticated manner (using IP address white-listing, for instance).
Configure the "Access-Control-Allow-Origin" HTTP header to a more restrictive set of domains, or remove all CORS headers entirely, to allow the web browser to enforce the Same Origin Policy (SOP) in a more restrictive manner.
zapFindings.name: Cross-Domain Misconfiguration
zapFindings.description: Web browser data loading may be possible, due to a Cross Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) misconfiguration on the web server.

zapFindings.solution: Ensure that your web server, application server, load balancer, etc. is configured to enforce Strict-Transport-Security.
zapFindings.name: Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set
zapFindings.description: HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) is a web security policy mechanism whereby a web server declares that complying user agents (such as a web browser) are to interact with it using only secure HTTPS connections (i.e. HTTP layered over TLS/SSL). HSTS is an IETF standards track protocol and is specified in RFC 6797.

zapFindings.solution: Ensure that your web server, application server, load balancer, etc. is configured to suppress "X-Powered-By" headers.
zapFindings.name: Server Leaks Information via "X-Powered-By" HTTP Response Header Field(s)
zapFindings.description: The web/application server is leaking information via one or more "X-Powered-By" HTTP response headers. Access to such information may facilitate attackers identifying other frameworks/components your web application is reliant upon and the vulnerabilities such components may be subject to.

zapFindings.solution: Ensure that your web server, application server, load balancer, etc. is configured to enforce Strict-Transport-Security.
